scenes.tts: Anfinsen was a tall, Lincolnesque figure at the NIH who reached for his viola when the science got too loud.
scenes.visual: portrait inset; NIH, tall Lincolnesque figure, viola when science got loud
scenes.narration: Anfinsen was a tall, Lincolnesque figure at the NIH who reached for his viola when the science got too loud.

scenes.tts: In 1960 he took ribonuclease apart with urea and beta-mercaptoethanol — a reagent that, the book notes, smells like rotten eggs crossed with skunk — and watched the enzyme collapse to zero activity, a random coil.
scenes.visual: timeline 1960; ribonuclease tiles; urea + beta-mercaptoethanol; activity gauge to zero; random coil
scenes.narration: In 1960 he took ribonuclease apart with urea and beta-mercaptoethanol — a reagent that, the book notes, smells like rotten eggs crossed with skunk — and watched the enzyme collapse to zero activity, a random coil.

scenes.tts: Then he washed the chemicals away and waited. The molecule found its way back to one hundred percent activity, the molecular equivalent of an egg unscrambling itself. No template, no helper, no instructions but its own sequence.
scenes.visual: chemicals washed away; waiting; refold; gauge to 100%; egg unscrambling; no template/helper/instructions; own sequence
scenes.narration: Then he washed the chemicals away and waited. The molecule found its way back to one hundred percent activity, the molecular equivalent of an egg unscrambling itself. No template, no helper, no instructions but its own sequence.

scenes.tts: He stated it plainly to the Royal Swedish Academy in his 1972 Nobel lecture: the native fold is the lowest free-energy state the sequence can reach, in a given environment.
scenes.visual: 1972 Nobel lecture; Royal Swedish Academy; free-energy landscape, ball settles in lowest state; given environment
scenes.narration: He stated it plainly to the Royal Swedish Academy in his 1972 Nobel lecture: the native fold is the lowest free-energy state the sequence can reach, in a given environment.

scenes.tts: Years later he left the lab and flew to Argentina during the Dirty War to confront government ministers over disappeared scientists. His method, the book observes, was the same one he had used on the enzyme: remove the denaturant, and see what refolds.
